categories.main_business_segments: Dah San Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing, processing, and sales of various electric wires, cables, and related accessories. The company also produces insulating materials, copper products, and undertakes electrical and telecommunication engineering design, construction, and maintenance services. Its product portfolio includes power cables, communication cables, electronic wires, bare copper wires, and specialized cables such as fire-resistant and heat-resistant cables.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including copper wire drawing, extrusion of insulation and sheathing materials (PVC, cross-linked polyethylene), and cable assembly processes. It emphasizes automation and intelligent manufacturing to improve operational efficiency. Dah San also focuses on developing high value-added products such as lightweight cables, customized cables, and cables meeting international certifications (UL, CSA, JIS).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include Taiwan Power Company (Taipower), Chunghwa Telecom, China Steel Corporation, and other state-owned enterprises. The company serves industries such as power transmission and distribution, telecommunications, electronics, construction, and renewable energy sectors. The domestic market dominates sales, with growing demand driven by infrastructure projects, urban renewal, green energy installations, and the return of Taiwanese manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dah San's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with domestic sales accounting for over 98% of revenue. Export markets include Asia (notably Japan and Southeast Asia) and Australia/New Zealand, focusing mainly on communication cables. The company is expanding its sales presence in northern and eastern Taiwan through new sales offices.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electric wire and cable supply chain, manufacturing finished cables and wires from raw materials such as copper and plastics. It sources raw materials globally, including copper plates and polymers, and supplies cables to downstream users like power utilities, telecom operators, and construction firms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include automation and intelligent manufacturing upgrades, development of high value-added and niche products (e.g., fire-resistant cables, fine control cables), and expansion into new markets domestically and internationally. R&D efforts focus on lightweight cables, customized materials, environmental-friendly compounds, and compliance with international standards. The company also emphasizes ESG initiatives and carbon reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of electric wires, cables, and related accessories. The company also earns income from engineering services related to power and telecommunication projects. Sales are predominantly one-time transactions with large industrial and utility customers, supplemented by long-term supply contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dah San competes with approximately 110 other wire and cable manufacturers in Taiwan, many of which have shifted production to China and Southeast Asia. The company positions itself as a high-quality, technology-driven manufacturer with a comprehensive product range from low to ultra-high voltage cables. It holds certifications such as ISO 9001, UL, CSA, and JIS, and is a key supplier to Taiwan Power Company, giving it a strong domestic market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024 (FY 113), Dah San reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$5.87 billion, an 18.7% increase over the prior year. Pre-tax profit was NT$921.6 million with net profit of NT$741.2 million, and earnings per share of NT$3.96. The company has demonstrated stable growth with improving profitability ratios and maintains a moderate debt-to-asset ratio of around 31%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dah San emphasizes stable, safe, and high-quality products supported by rigorous quality control and multiple international certifications. Its core competitive advantages include mature in-house production technology, a broad and complete product lineup covering low to ultra-high voltage cables, and the ability to customize products to meet specific customer needs. The company also focuses on automation and innovation to reduce costs and enhance product value, aligning with government infrastructure and green energy initiatives.
